Personality: Ecarand is an upright Vlandian lord with a strong sense of honor who upholds the chivalric virtue of mercy, frequently showing leniency toward the weak and captives. When it comes to wealth and resources, however, he is unusually calculating and even somewhat tight-fisted, a trait that has served him well in accumulating family fortune but often invites gossip from others. Far from reckless, he acts with steady deliberation, adept at weighing pros and cons without giving in to blind impulse or excessive opportunism. As a vassal under King Derthert, he is devotedly loyal to the crown while also serving as a seasoned cavalry commander and polearm master, renowned on the battlefield for his outstanding leadership and tactical prowess. He knows how to deploy his personal charm, though whenever his clan's interests are at stake, his shrewd side becomes unmistakable.
Background: Ecarand was born into the ancient Vlandian house of dey Fortes and underwent strict knightly training from childhood. Now in his forties and in the prime of life, he has dedicated himself to fighting for the glory of the Vlandian kingdom and his clan. As a loyal lord of Vlandia, he stands firmly behind King Derthert as one of the monarch's trusted military pillars. His skill at wielding a polearm on horseback is second to none, and as an accomplished tactician and leader, he has led his troops to victory on the battlefield time and again. Deeply aware of the importance of family legacy, he treasures his two daughters, Adalindis and Moriana, and strives to build a secure future for them. Placing his clan's interests above all else, he manages his estates with shrewd precision to ensure that the wealth and standing of Clan dey Fortes grow ever stronger.
